title: A Travel Magazine
text:
Anna reads a magazine every week. Her favorite magazine is about travel. It has many beautiful photos of cities and mountains. Anna likes the short articles because she can read them on the bus.

Last month, the magazine wrote an article about a small town in Italy. The writer visited the town for three days. He ate local food and talked to the people there. Anna wants to visit the town next summer.

questions.text: What is Anna's favorite magazine about?
How long did the writer stay in the town?
Why does Anna like the short articles?
options: Short articles are cheaper than long ones
She can finish them during a short bus ride
Her teacher gives them to her

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna from the passage?
options: She has already been to Italy
She is interested in travel and wants to visit new places
She writes articles for the magazine

vocabulary.definition: a regular publication with articles and photos
a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine
the one you like more than the others
belonging to or coming from a particular place

paragraph_translations: Анна читає журнал кожного тижня. Її улюблений журнал про подорожі. У ньому багато гарних фотографій міст і гір. Анна любить короткі статті, бо може читати їх в автобусі.
Минулого місяця журнал написав статтю про невелике місто в Італії. Автор відвідав це місто три дні. Він їв місцеву їжу і розмовляв з людьми там. Анна хоче відвідати це місто наступного літа.
